content_en.prompt: Ann and Bob put 4 bowling pins in a row. On their turn, a player drops either 1 pin or 2 adjacent pins; whoever drops the last pin wins. Ann plays first.
content_en.question: Which pin(s) should Ann drop first to guarantee her victory?
content_en.explanation: Dropping the middle pair (2nd and 3rd pins) leaves two separated single pins; whatever Bob does to one, Ann mirrors on the other, guaranteeing she drops the last pin. All other first moves let Bob win.
content_en.ct_explanation: This is an impartial combinatorial game called Kayles. The winning strategy: leave the opponent two equal, separated groups of pins, then mirror whatever they do to one group on the other. Representing a game as a tree and traversing it with search algorithms (the minimax/negamax procedure) is a fundamental and widely-used concept in informatics and AI, applicable to games like tic-tac-toe and chess.

content_zh.prompt: Ann和Bob把4根保齡球瓶排成一排。輪到誰時，可以放倒1根瓶子，或相鄰的2根瓶子；誰放倒最後一根瓶子就贏。Ann先手。
content_zh.question: Ann第一步應該放倒哪根(或哪兩根)瓶子，才能確保自己獲勝？
content_zh.explanation: 放倒中間那一對（第2根和第3根），會留下兩根分開的單獨瓶子；不管Bob對其中一根做什麼，Ann都在另一根上「照樣模仿」，就能保證自己放倒最後一根瓶子。其他任何第一步都會讓Bob獲勝。
content_zh.ct_explanation: 這是一種公平的組合遊戲，叫做「Kayles」。獲勝策略是：留給對手兩組數量相等、彼此分開的瓶子群，然後不管對手對其中一組做什麼，都在另一組上「照樣模仿」。把遊戲表示成一棵樹、再用搜尋演算法(minimax/negamax程序)遍歷它，是資訊科學和人工智慧裡非常基礎又廣泛使用的概念，也適用於井字遊戲、西洋棋這類遊戲。
